title: Crossref energy_security z>1 leads BASF returns (-) 5d
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Crossref Hormuz weekly counts 8-week z-score > 1 lead BASF returns by 5 days (-) via European gas input cost fear; trade short BAS.DE 5d [research.hormuz.crossref_pubs -> finance.BAS.DE.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: research.hormuz.crossref_pubs rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short BAS next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Null control: Crossref Hormuz publication share (not raw counts) 20d z-score > 1 leads BAS.DE returns by 5 days (-); if share also fails the crossref->BASF gas-fear channel is dead [research.hormuz.crossref_share -> finance.BAS.DE.log_return] (parent: R2-0030)
